summary: Frontend-only validation of Comms Phase-1 follow-up: redesigned Comms Centre module shell, Memberships→Emails embed, CRM→Communications embed, and shared-record integrity. All 5 review items PASS. No blocking issues found.
validated_features: Comms Centre /comms — unified header 'Comms Centre · Pulse Fitness AI Admin', today date, ModuleSwitcher row with Comms Centre pill active, CrossModuleTipsBanner, PillTabBar with 4 view pills (comms-view-all/marketing/memberships/crm) all rendering. Stat cards (stat-campaigns, stat-emails-sent, stat-open-rate, stat-click-rate) visible. comms-panel renders the campaign table.

View pills filter by module — clicking marketing/memberships pill updates URL to /comms?view=<id> and refetches; All view shows 13 campaigns (with module badges), Memberships view shows only memberships-module campaigns, CRM view shows only crm campaigns.

Memberships → Emails — /memberships, click data-pill-id='emails' renders memberships-emails-panel with stat-campaigns and a list of ONLY memberships-module campaigns (TEST_ma + Welcome blast = 2). memberships-emails-create-btn opens the comms-create-modal. No 'Not Found' toast (double /api fix verified).

CRM → Communications — module-switcher-crm cross-login navigates to /crm; clicking 'Communications' nav opens crm-comms-panel with stat cards and ONLY crm campaigns (TEST_sf, Sales follow-up = 1). crm-comms-create-btn present.

Shared-record integrity — created TEST_iter_p2_<ts> (member_announcement) from Memberships embed; EmailBuilder opened (builder-save visible); Save executed without error. Record appears in Comms Centre 'memberships' view AND 'all' view, but NOT in 'crm' view. No duplicate records.

EmailBuilder embed-launch — builder opens from inside Memberships embed with subject input, block palette (Logo/Heading/Paragraph/Image/Button/Divider), preview + quality badge ('1 err·1 warn'), Test and Save controls all rendered.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: CSP console errors for assets.emergent.sh / posthog / cloudflareinsights are environment-level (preview CSP) and unrelated to this iteration; ignore.
Minor: CampaignsPanel.js — duplicate handler (line 82) calls /api/comms/campaigns/{id}/duplicate. Backend was previously validated; no functional issue observed in this run.
seed_data_creation: Created one campaign 'TEST_iter_p2_<unix_ts>' (memberships module, member_announcement type) via the Memberships→Emails embed for shared-record integrity verification. Cleanup not performed (data is namespaced with TEST_ prefix).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Comms Phase-1 follow-up frontend changes (module-shell layout for /comms + Memberships Emails embed + CRM Communications embed + shared-record filter) are working end-to-end. Backend was validated at iteration_comms_p1.json (24/24). For future regression: login → /comms (verify all 4 view pills filter correctly), /memberships → click data-pill-id='emails', /comms → click data-testid='module-switcher-crm' → click 'Communications' nav.
